method: Actual Chromium HTMLVideoElement decoding, seek and >1.5s of observed playback for both original VP9 and H264. Decoded frame pixels must differ during actual playback. MP4 screenshots draw the HTMLVideoElement into Canvas because headless video overlay screenshots stayed stale; these are decoded frames, not source stills. Harness favicon is explicitly served204; full HTTP-downloaded Blob enables seeking without requiring Python-server Range support. Every requested seek checks actual currentTime.
